repository_gate.tests: offline,pure-Python project imports,no external services; pilot venv only

eligibility.linked_issue: Fixes/Closes/Resolves reference to same-repository issue,lowest issue number if several
eligibility.test_outcome: at least one hidden test call fails on first parent and all pass on historical fix; no collection/setup errors,skip or timeout
eligibility.public_smoke: up to five existing unchanged test functions from changed test modules,ordered qualified name,exclude hidden IDs; all pass on parent and fix

take: first four eligible PRs in fixed order; log every excluded candidate; if fewer than four eligible in pool,stop and report,do not silently extend pool or swap repository
observation_policy: no model/provider calls until protocol,case set,harness and tests delivered and coord-read accepts

proposed_live.author: codex
proposed_live.arms: source-only versus graph-assisted,alternating by selected task order

native_metrics: outcome,stage wall time,per-call native input/output/cache units,tool outcomes,graph witnesses and relative file reads; never estimate tokens or merge tokenizers as one cost
